card.text: The darkest of Uranus's large moons, about as reflective as the lunar highlands.

introduction.text: Voyager 2 spotted a bright ring on Umbriel's dark surface. It may be frost around an impact crater.

normal.title: Monochrome mosaic
normal.summary: Lighting is corrected, but shadows and seams in the photographs remain.

voyager-color.title: Voyager color map
voyager-color.summary: Voyager's own color frames, 17 km per pixel, placed by the moon's limb; the unlit north stays unavailable.
